duties.notes: Durrett Appendix A.4 (pp. 466-470) and Example 1.2.7 (pp. 13-14) were compared item by item: the signed-measure definition and its convention remark, Examples A.4.1-A.4.2 (the source's stale pointer 'Exercise 5.8' replaced by a written proof), positive and negative sets, Exercise A.4.1, Lemmas A.4.3-A.4.4, Theorem A.4.5 and the non-uniqueness remark with the a.e. description, mutual singularity, Exercise A.4.2, Theorem A.4.6, Exercise A.4.3, the remark on finite signed measures on R with total variation and the left endpoint, Theorem A.4.7, Exercise A.4.4, absolute continuity, Exercise A.4.5, Theorem A.4.8, Example A.4.9, the d nu/d mu notation, Exercises A.4.6-A.4.9, and Example 1.2.7 with its plateau values, absence of a density and mu(C^c) = 0. Each is supplied on the route with written proofs. Not reproduced, with content supplied: the drawing of Figure 1.5 (the plateau formula for every removed interval) and the reading pointer to Royden (1988), p. 103 (the analysis definition of variation is stated and proved equal to the measure).
